{"args":["-lc","python3 << 'PY'
import struct
data=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()
print(len(data))
# parse as btree leaf page at offset 0
ptype=data[0]
free=struct.unpack('>H',data[1:3])[0]
 ncells=struct.unpack('>H',data[3:5])[0]
cell_content=struct.unpack('>H',data[5:7])[0]
print(f"type={ptype:#x} free={free} ncells={ncells} cell_content={cell_content} frag={data[7]}")
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',data[8+i*2:10+i*2])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
print(ptrs)
# varint decode
def read_varint(buf, off):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[off+i]
        if i==8:
            v=(v<<8)|b
            return v, off+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7F)
        if not (b&0x80):
            return v, off+i+1
    return v, off+9
for idx, p in enumerate(ptrs):
    print(f"--- cell {idx} at {p} hex={data[p:p+40].hex()} ascii={data[p:p+40]!r}")
    try:
        sz, o = read_varint(data, p)
        rid, o2 = read_varint(data, o)
        print(f"  payload_len={sz} rowid={rid} header_off={o2} remaining={len(data)-o2}")
        # record parsing: header size varint, then serial types
        hs, ho = read_varint(data, o2)
        print(f"  header_size={hs} header_bytes={data[o2: o2+hs].hex()}")
        # decode serial types
        off=ho
        sts=[]
        while off < o2+hs:
            s, off = read_varint(data, off)
            sts.append(s)
        print(f"  serials={sts}")
        # decode values
        for s in sts:
            if s==0:
                print("   NULL")
            elif s==1:
                print(f"   int8 {data[off]}")
                off+=1
            elif s in (2,3,4):
                n={2:2,3:3,4:4}[s]
                print(f"   int {int.from_bytes(data[off:off+n],'big',signed=True)}")
                off+=n
            elif s==5:
                print(f"   int48 {int.from_bytes(data[off:off+6],'big',signed=True)}")
                off+=6
            elif s==6:
                print(f"   int64 {int.from_bytes(data[off:off+8],'big',signed=True)}")
                off+=8
            elif s==7:
                import struct as st
                print(f"   float {st.unpack('>d',data[off:off+8])[0]}")
                off+=8
            elif s>=13 and s%2==1:
                ln=(s-13)//2
                print(f"   text len {ln} {data[off:off+ln]!r}")
                off+=ln
            elif s>=12 and s%2==0:
                ln=(s-12)//2
                print(f"   blob len {ln} {data[off:off+ln].hex()}")
                off+=ln
            else:
                print(f"   serial {s} ?")
                break
        print(f"  end off={off} expected payload end={o2+sz} match={off==o2+sz} next_ptr={(ptrs[idx+1] if idx+1<len(ptrs) else cell_content)}")
    except Exception as e:
        import traceback; traceback.print_exc()

data=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()

ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',data[8+i*2:10+i*2])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
print(ptrs)

def read_varint(buf, off):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        b=buf[off+i]
        if i==8:
            v=(v<<8)|b
            return v, off+9
        v=(v<<7)|(b&0x7F)
        if not (b&0x80):
            return v, off+i+1
    return v, off+9
